convert_swiftformer_checkpoint: convert a SwiftFormer original checkpoint to HuggingFace SwiftFormerForImageClassification format
create_rename_keys: create key renaming rules to map original SwiftFormer state dict keys to HuggingFace model structure
build_swiftformer_model: build a SwiftFormer image classification model with configurable depths and embed dimensions
test_swiftformer_conversion: test SwiftFormer checkpoint conversion by comparing HuggingFace model logits against expected outputs
run_convert_cli: run the SwiftFormer checkpoint conversion CLI with model name, output path, and original checkpoint arguments
